summary: Retested the iteration_192 fixes. (1) Finance can now approve a campaign bill directly from the notification bell. Tested in the UI: manager created campaign TEST_RT and bill VB-00004. finance@ saw notif-approve-ntf_2e910ae93256 with title 'Setujui tagihan langsung'. Clicking it showed the notice 'Tagihan VB-00004 disetujui — Beban Pemasaran & Hutang dijurnal.' and the DB shows the bill as status=posted, approved_by Sri Mulyani. sales@ and warehouse@ do not get the notification at all, so they never see the button. (2) Backend partial return: tests/test_session3_extended_t1.py passed 5/5. In code review, duplicate roll ids get a 400 before any data changes, and failed cuts are recorded under failed_partial_roll_ids. (3) MakloonReturnMaterial partial qty in the UI (MKO-00009 created with qty 60, issued 60 yd, then cancelled; rolls 23.55 + 36.45): '100', 'abc', '0' and '-5' all show mko-return-partial-error-1 and disable mko-return-submit-1. '', '23.55' (full roll), '10' and '10,5' are accepted correctly. FAILED: the typo '1O' shows no error and the submit button stays enabled; it is quietly read as a 1-yard partial return (summary shows 37,45 yard). (4) The budget chart 'Anggaran' bar color is #7FA3E0, checked in code only.

ui_bugs.issue: partQty and badPart use parseFloat, which reads '1O' as 1 and '10abc' as 10. A typo is accepted as a valid partial qty with no error and the submit button enabled, and the roll is split by the wrong amount. The review request says '1O' must show the error.

integration_issues.flow: Finance inline approve from the bell
integration_issues.issue: Minor: after approving, approveFromNotification only reloads notifications. The finance desk board 'Tagihan supplier menunggu ACC (1)' still lists VB-00004 until the page is refreshed, and the notification card stays in the list (marked read, button gone).

action_items: MakloonReturnMaterial.jsx: validate partial qty strictly, e.g. const s=String(v).trim().replace(',', '.'); if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(s)) treat as invalid; then use Number(s). This makes '1O' and '10abc' show mko-return-partial-error and disable submit. Then rebuild the static bundle.
Optional: after a vendor_bill_approve from the bell, also refresh the desk waiting boards or the AP list so the approved bill disappears.
critical_code_review_comments: The backend checks for duplicates before any changes; Pydantic PartialReturnIn rejects non-numeric qty, so the backend is safe. Only the frontend parsing is loose.
canActOn now special-cases vendor_bill_approve to BILL_APPROVERS [finance, manager, admin]. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 fixes verified; the '1O' typo case fails)
